description: Six clock dividers driven from one trigger input, each with its own mute, over a shared swing and gate width

params.text: Sets the division that channel counts, from one to sixteen
Silences that channel's gate output; the module comes up with all six sounding
Delays the gates within each count, leaving every fourth count where it is
Sets how long the gates stay high as a fraction of the time between triggers

inputs.text: The clock: a gate above 0.5V advances every divider by one count
A gate above 0.5V sends the count back to the start
Moves that channel's division, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the swing, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the gate width, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt

outputs.text: A 5V gate each time that channel's division comes round
